question: In round 5, the first successful byte-identity check of the child-pair layout on the default scene (64 spp, seed 1, against out/r4_default.pfm) printed a setup line. What setup_ms did it show?
answer:
Answer: setup_ms=245.7.

How I know: the first successful byte-identity check of the child-pair layout on the default scene was history message #163 — the run `./pathtracer/pathtracer --scene-config scene-default.json --spp 64 --seed 1 --out-pfm out/cp_default.pfm --out out/cp_default.ppm` followed by `cmp out/cp_default.pfm out/r4_default.pfm`. Its stdout was:

  setup_ms=245.7 samples=16777216 width=512 height=512 spp=64 threads_used=4 triangles=69451 bvh_nodes=81521
  IDENTICAL_DEFAULT

Earlier attempts at the same check (#159, #162) failed before writing anything — #159 printed "scene error: cannot open scene..." and `cmp: out/cp_default.pfm: No such file or directory` — so #163 is indeed the first success (the two sandbox_extension warnings in that line are unrelated setup noise; the run itself completed and the PFM compared equal). The two remaining scenes in the same batch (#165) printed setup_ms=201.2 for alt-view and setup_ms=192.1 for caustic-closeup, both IDENTICAL.
